::: {#def-bipartite}
#### Bipartite graph

A graph $G = (V, E)$ (@def-graph-vertices-edges) is **bipartite** [@wikipedia_bipartite_graph]
if there are two sets $V_1$ and $V_2$ with $V_1 \cup V_2 = V$ and $V_1 \cap V_2 = \emptyset$ (@def-union, @def-intersection),
such that every edge has one endpoint in $V_1$ and the other endpoint in $V_2$.

:::
